## What changed
- `benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json`: the one string in the `answer_record_contract` `citations` list is now the #897 dict shape. It is the same as `library-specialty.json`, except the example locator says `Property[3]`, which is the icon-tests position. No other line changed.
- New dev file sha256 is `11a3c090886b7411c5b0d8cd55dbd6685ecf7d1654ec5a6ebc87b4ece2dcc1aa`. `benchmark/challenges/library-icon-tests.json` `source.inventory_sha256` was set to it.
- `benchmark/results/challenges.json` was regenerated with `python3 -B -I benchmark/scripts/score.py`.
- Pin maps were recomputed for all three changed files and for `benchmark/preparation.json`:
  - `benchmark/preparation.json`: 4 entries updated (challenges/2, challenges/7, oracle/7, tasks/12).
  - `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`: 3 file entries updated, plus the `benchmark/preparation.json` entry.

## Checks run
- `score.py --check` printed `{"cannot_evaluate": 0, "controls": 35, "fixtures": 3, "matches": 35, "mismatches": 0}`.
- The verification one-liner from the issue printed `OK`. It covers every entry of `protected_inputs_sha256` (whole map), no string citation left, and the inventory hash in the challenge file.
- A whole-map walk of `benchmark/preparation.json` over all 80 path+sha256 entries found 0 stale entries.
- `git status --porcelain` printed nothing. The environment says this directory is not a git repository, so that output proves nothing about stray files. I did not list the directory for `__pycache__`. Every Python call used `-B -I`.

## Live vs historical pin files
Method: counted occurrences of the three old file hashes and the old `preparation.json` hash in each file. All counts were 0 for all four files.
- `benchmark/writing/c1-challenges-0125-pins.json`: historical snapshot (0125 dated, hashes of earlier file versions). Left frozen.
- `benchmark/lineage.json`: historical snapshot. It pins none of the changed files' current hashes. Left frozen.
- `benchmark/writing/reviews-0128/c1-artifact-manifest-0126.json`: historical snapshot (review manifest, dated). Left frozen.
- `benchmark/preparation-status.json`: not a pin map for the changed files. Its own hash is pinned in `input-pins.json` and is unchanged. Left unchanged.

Limit: the "historical" call rests on the zero-hash counts and the dated names. I did not read those files whole to check what they do pin.

## Discoveries
- `benchmark/preparation.json` is itself pinned in `input-pins.json`. Any edit to it needs that entry refreshed, and I did so.
- No LabVIEW was run. N0001/N0002 stay unverified.
